【原视频简介】
I Built This PC From a Broken Old Laptop!

What happens when an old laptop is too damaged to use, but the hardware inside still works? Instead of throwing this broken laptop away, I decided to give it a completely new life by turning it into a desktop PC!

In this video, I take apart the broken laptop, remove all the usable components, and figure out how to transform them into a compact computer that can sit permanently on my desk.

Of course, building a PC from a broken laptop isn’t as simple as moving the motherboard into another case. I had to deal with limited space, cooling, ports, cables, the display, and plenty of unexpected problems along the way.

After modifying and assembling everything, this broken laptop slowly starts looking less like old electronic waste and more like a real desktop computer.

But the biggest question is whether it actually works. I’ll power up the broken laptop hardware, test the system, connect the peripherals, and see what kind of performance this homemade PC can deliver.

Can a broken laptop really become a useful desktop PC instead of ending up in the trash?

Watch until the end to see the complete transformation and find out whether this broken laptop PC build was actually worth it!
